answer: Require every agent to BURN a small fixed coin per action, not merely lock it—each burn is signed on-ledger like a quill pressing an indelible receipt. The spent coin runs off like a river, gone and unrecoverable, so it never compounds the way staked capital does. That sets a hard reef every identity must clear on its own: a Sybil running 1000 clones pays the burn 1000 separate times with zero recovery—a strictly linear per-identity cost floor no single shared deposit can amortize across the farm.
